function: S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) transporter of the mitochondrial inner membrane. Also transports S-adenosylhomocysteine (SAH). Probably catalyzes the uptake of SAM into the mitochondria, where it is required for the activity of BIO2, LIP5 and for methylation of DNA, RNA, proteins and other compounds, and the export of SAH, which is produced from SAM in the methylation reactions and hydrolyzed in the cytosol by SAH1. The rate of the exchange is much higher than that of the uniport. However, the uniport reaction is necessary in special conditions, when the intramitochondrial level of SAM has to be increased when cells divide or when cells are transferred to a medium containing non-fermentative carbon sources.
